elements.text:
Your parent is dropping you off at your sports practice. As they drop you off, they are really loud and everyone on your team looks at you. 

Here are some thoughts that might pop into mind:

texts: Lots of people have loud parents and my teammates might roll their eyes, but some will understand.
I think about the drills that we might do today during practice.
Even if my teammates heard my parent, they probably will forget about it soon.
My teammates will think I'm such a loser because my parent is annoying.
I'm lucky to have a parent that supports my hobbies.
